slots.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

slots.title: Uber launches parking service following SpotHero acquisition, with an eye on robotaxis
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Uber Parking is the latest example of the company offering products beyond its core ride-hailing service.

slots.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

slots.title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.

slots.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
